items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: We'll have to play this for Dick King. He's related to them.

ctx.x: No, no. I was housegirl and maid for Miss Nina King. Yes. Nina's the youngest one. I don't know if she's alive. I know Miss Annie died. But Miss Nina was a debutante then. And I was homemade and did the upstairs work.
We'll have to play this for Dick King. He's related to them. Oh. And ask him about it. He'll enjoy it. I know a relative of Miss King's family.
